answers.profileType: Profile type describes how you appear in the public marketplace. Company authority still comes from workspace memberships and permissions, not from the label alone.

howItWorks.title: How Buildink works for every role
howItWorks.description: Learn how public discovery, verification, posting and response work before creating an account.
howItWorks.sectionOneBody: Each role follows a clear path from public discovery into the protected activities available in its portal.

cards.card1Body: Publish company identity, projects and requests, then manage approved contact paths in your workspace.
cards.card2Body: Show skills and services, respond to compatible opportunities and manage interactions from the portal.
cards.card3Body: Publish eligible catalogs and equipment and manage enquiries without exposing private information.

verification.title: What Buildink verifies - and what it does not
verification.description: Verification shows specific checks completed by Buildink, protects private evidence and provides a clear route for reporting concerns.
verification.sectionOneBody: A badge improves transparency about specific checks, but it does not replace professional, technical or commercial due diligence.

cards.card1Body: A badge indicates that specific information was checked at a point in time; it does not guarantee future performance.
cards.card2Body: Identity documents, verification evidence and other private files stay outside the public marketplace.
cards.card3Body: You can report inaccurate, unsafe or misleading public content and provide the context needed for review.

about.title: About Buildink
about.description: Buildink is designed to make construction discovery, verification and collaboration clearer, starting with the Italian market.
about.sectionOneTitle: A platform grounded in real work
about.sectionOneBody: Buildink brings together information and workflows that are often fragmented across contacts, documents and separate tools.

cards.card1Body: Reduce friction and fragmented information when people and companies look for opportunities and partners in construction.
cards.card2Body: Companies, professionals, suppliers, equipment owners, workers and project owners use role-specific pathways.
cards.card3Body: Verification, privacy, authorization and transparency support the move from public discovery to protected workflows.

contact.sectionOneBody: Requests are routed by topic while information that should remain private stays out of public pages.

cards.card2Body: Public pages show only business and contact information approved for publication.
cards.card3Body: The form validates the required information and explains what happens after submission.
